verses.1: And if you are a king, or if you are a ruler, who are you? Are you not God who created you?
verses.2: And he brought you from where you were not, so that you might do his will and walk in his commandment and fear his judgment, just as you are obeyed by your servants and have authority over them; even so there is one who is obeyed by you and has authority over you.
verses.3: And just as you stretch out the rod of mercy upon those who do wrong, even so there is God who will stretch out his rod upon you and cast you into judgment, where there is no escape for ever.
verses.4: And just as you punish the one who does not submit to you and does not come to you, why do you not come and submit yourself to God?
verses.5: And just as you desire that men should fear you, why do you not fear God your God, for it is he who created you and made you king over all his work, so that you might shepherd his people and his flock in righteousness?
verses.6: And do not show partiality to the face of the great or the small, but judge with righteousness and uprightness, as God has commanded you. Fear him whom you ought to fear; keep his ways and his commandments.
verses.7: And do not turn aside to the right or to the left, as Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying to them, I have set before you fire and water; stretch out your hand to whichever you choose.
verses.8: And hear the word which I have established for you, that you may hear his voice and do his commandment. And as it is said, There is no need to cross the sea, saying, Who will cross over for us and bring it to us, that we may hear it and do it?
verses.9: And if you say again, Who will go up for me into heaven and bring down for me that word of God, that I may hear it and do it?—he says, Behold, the word is near to you, in your mouth and in your hand.
verses.10: And if you do not listen to the scripture, you have not listened to God your God; and if you do not receive my word, I will not love you, nor will I make you do his commandment.
verses.11: And you, while you live, will enter into the judgment that is for ever, because you did not love his commandment and did not do the will of him who exalted you and honored you above all your people, that you might shepherd them in your righteousness.
verses.12: And he set you above and as head over all his people, while you remember the name of your God who created you and gave you power to judge the people in righteousness and uprightness.
verses.13: And from those who sin against you, in what you reprove and in what you teach, remember the way of God, and set your heart in order and judge uprightly.
verses.14: And when they are accused before you, do not show partiality, and do not take a bribe from a man to show him favor, nor from an innocent man to oppress him; for yours is the whole earth.
verses.15: And if you do his will, he will prolong your days.
verses.16: Remember that you will be raised from death and will stand before his face, and will be examined concerning all that you have done, whether evil or good.
verses.17: And if you have done good, you will dwell in the habitation of the good kings, in the houses of light; but if you have done evil, you will dwell in the habitation of the evil kings, and God will not be ashamed to command your disgrace.
verses.18: And when you see the greatness of your majesty, and the multitude of your armies, and the abundance of your fields, and your horses standing ready, and the chariots that are under your hand, and those who blow the trumpet and contend in battle before you,
verses.19: and when you see all this, do not lift up your heart and stiffen your neck, and do not forget him who gave you all this glory. For if he says to you, Depart, you will depart.
verses.20: And your glory will go to another, for you have become blind, blinded concerning the food with which he fed you.
verses.21: And there he will examine you and reckon with you and judge you, for in the evening death will come upon you, and at the resurrection judgment will take place, and the deeds of men will be examined.
verses.22: And for the kings of the earth there is none who will honor them, and for the rulers of the earth their crown of counsel will fall; for rich and poor will stand together in judgment, and in judgment, for he is the judge of righteousness.
verses.23: In judgment there is trembling, and the soul shakes, and the books are opened, and the deeds of men are revealed, and there is nothing hidden.
verses.24: At the resurrection of the dead, the earth will bring forth the wombs that were formed upon her, just as a woman cannot close her womb when the time has come for the child to be born, and cannot restrain what comes forth from her womb.
verses.25: Or can the clouds restrain the drops of rain, so that they do not go where God has commanded them, so that they do not fall? Even so it is impossible that the dead should not be raised when the time of the resurrection has come; for the word of God brought all things from nothing, and the word of God brought all things into being.
verses.26: And again, the word of God brings forth all things from below, as Moses said, Man does not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.
verses.27: Behold, it is known that by the word of God the dead live.
verses.28: And again it says in the second law concerning those who become kings and rulers and who do his will: In the place of judgment I will curse them, and in time their feet will slip, for the day of their destruction is near.
verses.29: And again God says to those who do not acknowledge his judgment, Acknowledge, acknowledge that I am God; I kill and I make alive.
verses.30: I wound and I heal; I bring down to Sheol, and again I bring up to heaven, and there is none who can deliver from my hand.
verses.31: Thus says God concerning kings and rulers who do not keep his commandment: Keep my law and my ordinance, that you may enter into my kingdom which is for ever; for the kingdom that is on earth is passing away, and it vanishes from morning until evening.
verses.32: For the power belongs to God, for glory and for diminishment; this one he diminishes, and this one he honors.
verses.33: The one who does not do his will, he will bring low; and the one who does his will, he will establish.
